thumb.title: Sculpted Goddess
thumb.text: Rebuilding and modernising a data-heavy SSR web application from Python/Flask to Next.js for performance, maintainability, and scalability.

page.subTitle: Recipe & Fitness Platform – Full Rebuild Case Study
page.text: Sculpted Goddess started as a data-driven nutrition and fitness web application, originally built several years ago using Python (Flask). While the first version was functional, it became increasingly difficult to maintain and scale over time. To demonstrate modern frontend architecture, performance optimization, and long-term maintainability, I later re-engineered the entire platform using Next.js and TypeScript, keeping the core product idea while significantly improving the technical foundation and user experience. This project reflects the type of problems I solve for clients: Modernising legacy applications, Improving performance and SEO with Next.js, Rebuilding products without losing core business logic, Designing scalable frontend architectures, Combining UX/UI design with real-world development. Perfect for: Startups with outdated tech, Businesses migrating from monoliths, Performance-critical content platforms, Product-focused web applications.
page.programLanguages: Next.js (Server-Side Rendering), TypeScript, SCSS, libSQL, External API integration (previously Edamam Recipe Search, now MealDB)
